name: linkedin-marketing
description: Weekly LinkedIn carousel posts: researches your company and industry, designs the slides in Canva, writes the copy, and hands you a ready-to-upload PDF. Can also find posts that mention you and comment on the ones you approve.

company_name.title: Company name
company_name.description: The company these posts are for. Used to pre-fill marketing-config.md during setup.

company_website.title: Company website
company_website.description: Full URL, e.g. https://example.com. The researcher reads this site to learn what you do.

audience.title: Who you're posting to
audience.description: e.g. 'security leaders at mid-size banks'. Leave blank to decide during setup.

cadence_days.title: Days between posts
cadence_days.description: How often a new carousel is due. 7 means weekly.

auto_start.title: Start the post automatically when due
auto_start.description: Off: Claude offers to run it. On: Claude begins researching as soon as you open this project. Leave off unless you want it fully hands-off.

canva_mode.title: How Canva builds the slides
canva_mode.description: Type one of: auto (detect your Canva plan), brand-template (always autofill your Brand Template, needs Canva Pro), or generate (always build from a prompt, works on Canva Free).

brand_template_id.title: Canva Brand Template ID
brand_template_id.description: Optional. The 1080x1080 Brand Template to autofill. Leave blank and setup will find it for you.

posts_dir.title: Where to save posts
posts_dir.description: Folder for finished post packages, relative to your project.

watch_mentions.title: Watch for posts that mention us
watch_mentions.description: Off: nothing changes. On: setup turns on mention checks, and Claude offers to run one when it is due. Comments are never posted without your approval of each one.

mention_terms.title: Extra terms to watch for
mention_terms.description: Optional, comma-separated. Searched alongside the company name — product names, a founder's name, a branded phrase. Leave blank to watch the company name only.

mention_check_days.title: Days between mention checks
mention_check_days.description: How often a mention check is due. 7 means weekly. 0 switches the reminder off.

max_comments_per_run.title: Most comments to post in one run
max_comments_per_run.description: A hard cap, whatever you approve. LinkedIn restricts accounts that comment at volume, so keep this low.
